newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Americel eyes Nortel B Band equipment deal.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Americel eyes Nortel B Band equipment deal.

text.p: Canadian-led consortium Americel S.A. said it has issued a letter of intent to buy cellular equipment from Canada's Nortel for its B Band cellular concession in central-western Brazil.
"They have presented a letter of intent and a contract is expected to be signed in mid-August," said a spokeswoman for the consortium.
Americel, which includes BCE Inc's Bell Canada and Telesystem International, last month won bidding to provide cellular services in B Band area seven, which includes Brasilia.
The spokeswoman denied a local news agency report that the group had signed a contract with Nortel. The Globo agency also said local firm Promon would be responsible for installing the equipment.

Americel, which also includes Citibank, local bank Opportunity and pension funds owned by Banco do Brasil, was the lone bidder for area 7, also made up of Acre, Goias, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Rondonia and Tocantins states.
The group offered of 338.5 million reais, some 25.4 percent above the base price.
